APPLICATION_DUPLICATE: {{participant}} is already registered for the term “{{term}}” (same name and date of birth).
APPLICATION_NOT_EDITABLE: This application can no longer be edited: it has no active term, or all its terms are over.
BED_ALREADY_TAKEN: The bed has meanwhile been taken by someone else.
CANCELLATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Changes now require the organizer's approval. Contact the organizer.
CANCELLATION_START_IN_PAST: The approval start date must not be in the past.
CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: Confirming would exceed the capacity of the term. Confirm knowingly.
CHANGE_REQUEST_NOT_PENDING: This request has already been decided. Refresh the list.
CHANGE_REQUEST_NOT_REQUIRED: This change takes effect immediately. Refresh the application.
CHANGE_REQUEST_PENDING: A request is already awaiting approval for this application.
CHANGE_REQUEST_STALE: The application has changed since this request was sent. Refresh the detail.
EMAIL_DELIVERY_FAILED: The verification e-mail could not be sent. Try again later.
EMAIL_VERIFICATION_BYPASS_DISABLED: Skipping e-mail verification is not available here.
EMAIL_VERIFICATION_BYPASS_NOT_ALLOWED: This account can't be verified without the e-mail link.
EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Verify your e-mail address before continuing.
EVALUATION_MODE_LOCKED: This event already accepts applications, so the evaluation mode can no longer be changed.
EVENT_HAS_APPLICATIONS: An event with applications cannot be deleted.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this.
HEALTH_CHANGE_REQUEST_REQUIRED: The health restriction has already been filled in. Send a change request to the organizer instead.
HEALTH_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Tick the explicit consent with processing of the data before saving.
HEALTH_REQUEST_NOT_NEEDED: There is nothing to change yet. Fill in the health restriction directly.
INTERNAL: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
INVALID_RESPONSE: The server response could not be read. Please try again.
INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: This change is not possible from the current status of the application in the term.
MANUAL_FILL_NOT_AVAILABLE: Filling a freed bed by hand is available only when applications are evaluated manually.
ORGANIZATION_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: Complete your organization's profile before creating an event.
PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Set your password first, then you can continue.
PAYMENT_ALREADY_RECORDED: This payment was already recorded with a different amount. Refresh the detail.
PAYMENT_TERM_NOT_IN_APPLICATION: The selected term does not belong to this application.
PHOTO_INVALID_TYPE: The photo has to be a JPG, JPEG or PNG image.
PHOTO_TOO_LARGE: The photo is too large. Choose a photo up to 2 MB.
PROGRAM_DAY_OUTSIDE_TERM: This day is not in the term ({{startsOn}} – {{endsOn}}). Choose another day.
PROGRAM_END_BEFORE_START: The end must be after the start.
PUBLIC_PAGE_INCOMPLETE: Fill in the description, the place and a contact e-mail before listing the event in the catalog.
REFUND_EXCEEDS_OVERPAYMENT: The amount exceeds the current overpayment. Refresh the detail and check the refunded amount.
REFUND_TERM_REQUIRED: A refund must be recorded for a specific term.
ROOM_COPY_NAMES_TAKEN: The term already has rooms named {{names}}. Rename or delete them first, or replace the existing rooms instead.
ROOM_NAME_TAKEN: A room with this name already exists in the event.
TERM_CANCELLED: This term was cancelled and can't be changed.
TERM_ENDED: This term is already over, so it can no longer take applications.
TERM_END_BEFORE_START: Enter an end date that is not before the start date.
TERM_LIMIT_REACHED: The event already has the maximum number of terms (999).
TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
TRANSPORT_AFTER_TERM_END: The departure can't be after the term ends ({{endsOn}}).
TRANSPORT_HAS_PARTICIPANTS: This transport has {{count}} participant(s) who chose it. Confirm the deletion to continue.
TRANSPORT_OWN_EXISTS: Own transport is already added to this term.
TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE: This transport is no longer available. The offer has been refreshed.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are not filled in correctly.
